title: Warm Irish Potato Crumble
description: A hearty and comforting Irish-inspired dish featuring tender potatoes topped with a crunchy crumble.
instructions: Peel and dice the potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
In a large saucepan, combine the diced potatoes and enough cold water to cover them.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the potatoes are tender when pierced with a fork.
Drain the potatoes and return them to the saucepan.
Add the butter, milk, salt, and pepper to the potatoes, and stir until the potatoes are well coated.
Transfer the potato mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
Sprinkle the Warm Irish Crumble Mix evenly over the top of the potatoes.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the crumble is golden brown and the potatoes are heated through.
Garnish with fresh chives, if desired.
